transcript: Speaker A: बाहर साफ़-साफ़ लिखा है English is compulsory. फिर भी आ गए मुंह उठा कर, अनपढ़ कहीं के। [It is clearly written outside that English is compulsory. Still you came here, you uneducated person.] Speaker B: First of all, don't judge the book by its cover. I'm not uneducated, I'm a B.Com graduate. And as for speaking English, well, you can see it for yourself. I'm fully capable of speaking English more fluently and confidently than you. Speaker A: Sorry, लेकिन आपको देखने से नहीं लगता कि आप इतनी English बोलते होंगे। कहाँ से सीखी इतनी फर्राटेदार English? [Sorry, but looking at you, it doesn't seem like you would speak so much English. Where did you learn such fluent English?] Speaker B: English सीखो ऐप से। [From English Seekho app.] Speaker A: English सीखो ऐप? ये क्या है? [English Seekho app? Where everything from basic level word-to-word sentence building to advanced level fluent English speaking is taught step-by-step in very easy language by experts. And yes, its AI coach is very good. Anyone can practice English 1-on-1 with it anytime to make their English fluent.] Speaker A: अरे वाह! English सीखो ऐप तो बड़ा सही ऐप है। हर कोई सीखो, एक बार तो download करना ही चाहिए। [Oh wow!
